synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 5‑minute peak RRP 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (interval end) (evidence: ev0446).
summary: Peak 5-minute RRP in VIC1 was 406.00544 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (2026-08-19T23:10:00Z) (ev0446).
The dispatch TOTALDEMAND at that 5-minute interval was 6639.92 MW (ev0447) and net interchange at that interval was -718.24 (net flow into VIC1, import) (ev0448).

Operational demand (half-hour) in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) was 6812.0 MW (ev0922). The window maximum operational demand was 7485.0 MW at interval ending 2026-08-20 08:30 AEST (ev0940).
Six 5-minute intervals met or exceeded the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window (intervals_at_or_above_threshold 6, ev0894; analysis_threshold 300.0 $/MWh, ev0896).

The Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus tie market notice gives 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (2026-08-20T01:00:00Z), after the price extreme interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST and after the last 5-minute interval at or above the analysis threshold ending 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:45 AEST.

possible_explanations.statement: Local generator output reductions or increases in dispatchable unit outputs might have contributed to high prices; SCADA observations show large changes in some units (for example STOCKYD1 change -302.29 MW [ev0952], MACARTH1 change -277.0 MW [ev0955], MURRAY increased 517.7 MW [ev0949]).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit dispatch records, trip reports and MMS offer/dispatch traces for the interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) and adjacent dispatch intervals to see if units tripped or offers changed and their timing.

possible_explanations.statement: An interconnector flow limit or a binding network constraint might have contributed to the price extreme (dispatch net interchange was -718.24, net flow into VIC1, at the peak interval) (ev0448).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine MMS constraint activation logs and DISPATCHINTERCONNECTORRES around interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) to see if interconnector limits or outage-related constraints were active and their marginal values.

possible_explanations.statement: The Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus tie market notice [c1] might be relevant to market conditions later on that day but the notice itself gives 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (2026-08-20T01:00:00Z), which is after the peak interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (see published finding c1).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Review the Network Outage Scheduler and MMS constraint history for any earlier constraints or short-notice submissions related to the Hazelwood tie before 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST); if none exist, the 11:00 AEST notice [c1] is temporally after the spike.
